description: What is on each part of a parcel: every crop or land-use subparcel with a stable crop_code, the crop name in the requested language, the original label of the source, area in m2, kind (cadastral, declaredCrop, landCover), a common use_class (arable, vineyard, olive, forest...), intensity, land type and class, source and, with include_geometry, its GeoJSON outline. Spain (Catastro, including Bizkaia, Alava, Navarre; Gipuzkoa without outlines), Austria, Estonia and Greece. One API call; free when the parcel has none. If the source does not answer it returns SUB_001: nothing is charged, retry in a few seconds. Translate codes with get_crop_catalog.

country.description: Optional country code (ES, PV, NA, AT, EE, GR...). Omit to auto-detect.

include_geometry.description: Include the GeoJSON outline of each subparcel (large). Default false.

reference.description: Official cadastral reference of the parcel

name: get_parcel_subparcels
title: Get Parcel Subparcels
